title: Recover original bridge proxy launch environment and pipe-token format

scope.claim: Recovers the embedded profile-launcher's exact LWBRIDGE_PROFILE_ID, LWBRIDGE_INSTANCE_ID, LWBRIDGE_PIPE_TOKEN and LWBRIDGE_BUILD_ID bindings, proves both recovered CreateProcessW launch branches inherit those values through lpEnvironment=NULL, recovers the original pipeToken producer as 32 random bytes encoded as 43-character unpadded Base64URL, and proves that this is a distinct contract from the rebuild's existing 64-character lowercase-hex lifecycle challenge. The implementation is offline-only and does not mutate a process environment or launch a child.

descriptorLayoutProof.remainingDescriptorCopy: embedded RVA 0x199DD-0x199EE copies remaining descriptor beginning at [rbp+0x08], making [rbp+0x08]=instanceId and [rbp+0x20]=pipeToken

childInheritance.meaning: the launched child inherits the profile-launcher's process environment, including the four recovered LWBRIDGE identity/build variables

pipeTokenProducer.descriptorSerialization: outer RVA 0x1D846E takes LaunchDescriptor.pipeToken from state +0x3A0; field-name write at RVA 0x1D84C9

protectedArtifact.rawTokenForwarding: outer RVA 0x1D80D1/0x1D80D8 forwards the same launch-state token slice into helper 0x3E002A
protectedArtifact.protectionPath: helper 0x3E002A forwards that slice to RVA 0x39F4C5, which calls CryptProtectData and then Base64-encodes the protected blob
protectedArtifact.boundary: the protected blob is a separate launch artifact and is not treated as the raw control-pipe handshake token

challengeSeparation.conclusion: Do not alias the rebuild lifecycle challenge to the original LWBRIDGE_PIPE_TOKEN.

registryLink.knownRegistryContract: instanceId key with profileId, SHA-256(token), expiry deadline and claimed flag from LWB-R7-098
registryLink.currentProof: the registration worker token ABI is recovered, but this checkpoint does not yet claim a complete instruction-level alias from launch-state +0x3A0 to the registration token slice
registryLink.status: PARTIAL; do not substitute challenge or assume equality without finishing this data-flow trace

coverage: exact four recovered identity/build variable names
32-byte deterministic fixture to exact 43-character unpadded Base64URL
no '=', '+', or '/' in encoded pipe token
64-character lowercase-hex rebuild challenge remains distinct from recovered pipe token

remainingBlocker: Finish the raw pipeToken-to-registry registration alias trace, then recover/implement authentic production listener ownership and outstanding-call lifecycle before enabling allowlisted call_lua(getStatus) or exposing non-null get_status.pending.
